findings.issue: The PASS contract only requires observedEnd after observedStart, allowing a trial shorter than the required 72-hour observation window.

Required metrics omit effective operating time, scheduled fault count and recovery duration; waiting measurements cover only repos with deliverables instead of every authorized repo required by issue #38.
The documented health receipt command omits mandatory --home and exits 1 without writing the external heartbeat receipt.
The Herdr trial runbook prescribes doctor --live, whose worker-cli probe only accepts the Codex adapter and therefore always fails for the prescribed Herdr adapter.

summary: Fixed four trial-contract/runbook defects: the missing 72-hour minimum, incomplete required metrics and all-repo wait evidence, missing heartbeat --home, and the Codex-only live probe prescribed for Herdr. Four new regression checks failed before the fixes; all 8 contract tests and 13 retained regressions now pass with typecheck/build green. Full-suite round 1 still has 5 failures in unchanged account-dependent repair fixtures (2020 passed); round 2 was stopped, and real-host issue #38 acceptance remains NOT_RUN.
